name: Get Transitions
description: Gets either all transitions or a transition that can be performed by the user on an issue, based on the issue's status. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-transitions-get)

configurable_props.name: issueIdOrKey
configurable_props.label: Issue ID or Key
configurable_props.description: The ID or key of an issue

configurable_props.name: skipRemoteOnlyCondition
configurable_props.label: Skip Remote Only Condition
configurable_props.description: Whether transitions with the condition *Hide From User Condition* are included in the response

configurable_props.name: includeUnavailableTransitions
configurable_props.label: Include Unavailable Transitions
configurable_props.description: Whether details of transitions that fail a condition are included in the response

configurable_props.name: sortByOpsBarAndStatus
configurable_props.label: Sort by Ops Bar and Status
configurable_props.description: Whether the transitions are sorted by ops-bar sequence value first then category order (Todo, In Progress, Done) or only by ops-bar sequence value

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description: Use expand to include additional information about transitions in the response. This parameter accepts `transitions.fields`, which returns information about the fields in the transition screen for each transition. Fields hidden from the screen are not returned. Use this information to populate the fields and update fields in [Transition issue](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issues/#api-rest-api-3-issue-issueidorkey-transitions-post).
